name: MINE! MINE! MINE!
source:
There are two all-powerful Witches that hold control over the world. Each can cast their spell:

- diabolus ex machina (noun) an unexpected new event, character, ability, or object introduced to drastically worsen the situation for the protagonists or significantly improve conditions for the villains, often as a dramatic plot device.
- deus ex machina (noun) an unexpected power or event saving a seemingly hopeless situation, especially as a contrived plot device.

And the world moves as such!

Brawler, a fearsome warrior known throughout the land, not only for his impressive battle skills but also for his shameless go-happy ways, finds himself and friends in a remarkable crossfire between mafiosos seeking retribution against the royal family and the looming corruption of the kingdom.

He meets the Silas Family, a ragtag of medieval mafiosos who prophesize a global war is about to commence. The Silas Family are the apple of his eye, Conquerors he admires, and perhaps, the last hope to make it through the collapse of Rosebell.
